title: migration fails without shadow database
l0: The migration command failed because the shadow database was absent.
l1: Create the shadow database first, then rerun the migration command.

title: schema migration needs separate shadow store
l0: Schema migration errors until a separate shadow store exists.
l1: Provision the temporary shadow store before running the same migration again.

title: migration fixed by connection pool reset
l0: The same migration command failed after stale pool state blocked schema access.
l1: Restart the local database pool before rerunning the migration.

title: storybook preview fixed by missing decorator
l0: Storybook preview failed because the theme decorator was absent.
l1: Add the theme decorator before running the preview build.
